### Q8 follow-up: preserve the public ChromaHfPolicy variant spelling

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q8-preserve-chroma-policy-api/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Repair the source-compatibility regression introduced when Phase Q8 renamed the public ChromaHfPolicy::QualityLowRateB5 enum variant. Retain the historical variant as the actual enum discriminant, expose QualityChroma as a descriptive associated-constant alias for new code and documentation, keep the graduated Q8 X/B behavior and all codestream outputs unchanged, and correct the Q8 optimization note to describe the compatibility alias accurately. Add tests pinning both spellings and exhaustive matching through the legacy variant.
